about: Features of the board and pipelines that earlier revisions had or have, so a rebuild cannot drop one silently. status: retained (present now), restored (removed earlier, back now), replaced (a deliberate redesign does the same job), needs_decision (removed, restoring contradicts the current design). check says where the proof lives in the current tree.

features.title: Presenter keys t l m i x s n a r p d and 1-9 drive the simulators
Left and Right arrow keys pick the focused store
Light by default, explicit dark toggle remembered per browser
Pause shoppers toggle
Close or open a store, and click a till to switch it
Store events opens the latest raw till record
Telemetry endpoint opens the store's latest snapshot
Warehouse endpoint feed with record JSON on click and arrivals per minute
One swipe: at the register versus what left the store
Kept in the store list with reasons
Warehouse's own card-number scan reads zero
A silent till is flagged to the store display and the board
Clean records queue on the store's disk and drain once after an outage
Failed scans stay in the store with their reason
Tills commit to a store database; jobs collect the backlog and acknowledge after delivery
Step explorer with the real input and output of each stage
Each store's window display shows the top seller of the last 10-second sales window and silent tills
features.note: pos-guard sends the sales window again; the fixture run checks the units per category.

features.title: The Cloud badge counts running jobs, for example pos-guard 4/4 and pos-uplink 4/4
On-screen reminder to pick a store and click a till
features.note: Moved from the page footer into the presenter bar so the board keeps its height.

features.title: Dashed lane and particles from Expanso Cloud to each store node on every control-plane poll
features.note: Restored as one dashed control bus in the corridor under the Cloud badge, one drop in each channel beside the store fronts (the outer right edge when the stores stack) and a short stub into each node's right side; particles run down and back on every control-plane poll. The 2 by 2 layout is unchanged and no lane crosses a store front. Screenshots: docs/screenshots/board-control-*.png.
